dossier.scp_unleashed.058.title: Heart of Darkness
dossier.scp_unleashed.058.caption: SCP-058 at rest in its holding cell, point forward, tendrils coiled beneath.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-058 is to be held in a reinforced cell at least twelve metres on a side, with a ceiling as strong as its walls. It climbs, and it will use the ceiling.
No personnel enter the cell while SCP-058 is active. Observation is by camera only.
**Livestock of any kind is to be kept away from the containment wing.**
Personnel assigned to this file are to avoid any unnecessary slaughter of livestock.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-058 is a mass of glossy red tissue shaped like a heart, about a metre long and narrower than it is long. It is carried low on four long, jointed legs and lies tilted, its rounded point forward and low, its broad end raised behind. A few short, blunt stumps rise from the broad end. Each leg ends in a curved claw the colour of old bone. A thick, segmented tail rises from the broad end and arches forward over the body, ending in a black stinger.
Two thin black tendrils lie coiled beneath the point. SCP-058 can throw them out to roughly four metres, strike with them, and drag its target back toward itself.

SCP-058 is extremely aggressive. It pursues people on sight and animals when no people are near, and it is faster than any running person. It climbs walls without difficulty and closes short distances in a single leap. Those struck by its stinger report a creeping sickness and a darkening of vision that lasts some seconds.
A heartbeat can be heard near SCP-058 at all times. The beat quickens when it hunts. %rStaff are advised to listen for it.%r
SCP-058 is very durable, but it can be destroyed.

page.title: Addendum 058-1: Appearance
text: SCP-058 has no recovery site. Every recorded appearance has followed the slaughter of livestock close by, within moments of the animal falling.
Why some slaughters are followed by an appearance and others are not is unknown. %rThe connection is not understood.%r

page.title: Addendum 058-2: Field Note
page.text: If you hear a second heartbeat where there should be none, do not stop at a door. It climbs. Get to open ground and keep moving.

message.scp_unleashed.scp058.arrival: The heart is still beating. It is not the cow's.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp058_heart_spaw: SCP-058, the Heart of Darkness: a heart-shaped Keter entity, point forward, carried on four long, clawed legs. It has %s health and %s armour.
It hunts players, villagers, people and animals, outruns a sprinting player, climbs walls and leaps at its prey.
Its tendrils lash out to about %s blocks and drag the target in. Its stinger hits for %s and leaves the victim poisoned and half blind.
It does not occur naturally. Its archive file has more on where it comes from.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp058.spawn.fail: There is no room for SCP-058 there
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp058.0: No recovery site is on record.
